integrity: The analytic derivation includes every sign chamber and singular boundary. Rational tests are supplementary, not a universal proof. Originality is bounded by inspected sources; no independent scientific validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Least-period-two algebraic orbit census for integer 1<=k<d, real a>0, 0<nu<2 only. No stability, attraction, entropy, higher-period or endpoint-parameter claim. The planar d=2,k=1 subcase and bisecting-continuum mechanism are previously known.
title: Delay-parity bifurcations of prime-two cycles in the generalized Lozi recurrence
